customProducts.name: Dedicated oven · size allowance
customProducts.detail: Separate 60 cm-class oven opening, below the microwave in the tower. Outer tower width is 65 cm; final niche, ventilation, support, circuit and door opening follow the actual model.

customProducts.name: Cooktop · size allowance
customProducts.detail: 75 cm-class cooktop over a 90 cm base, on the utility-facing wall continuation to the right of the doorway. Width / cut-out / countertop thickness / gas or induction choice to confirm. Not wholly within the short partition directly shared with utility.

customProducts.name: Mixer grinder · size allowance
customProducts.detail: 30 × 35 cm countertop parking allowance. Jars, lid removal, cord and working space need the eventual model. Can store in the cabinet below when not in use.

customProducts.name: Juicer · size allowance
customProducts.detail: 25 × 35 cm countertop parking allowance. Tall slow juicers or a large pulp container may exceed it. Allow space for feed chute, dismantling and cleaning.

customProducts.name: Coffee maker · size allowance
customProducts.detail: 35 × 45 cm parking allowance for a compact machine, not a selected model. A separate grinder, bean storage, water-tank access or large espresso setup may need a wider station.

customProducts.name: Utility dishwasher · size allowance
customProducts.detail: Separate 60 cm-class dishwasher. Proposed 65 × 65 × 90 cm bay includes an illustrative worktop; final niche, hoses, connections, ventilation and door projection follow the actual model. The dashed 60 cm opening allowance is a study, not the manufacturer door dimension.

customProducts.name: Front-load washing machine · size allowance
customProducts.detail: Separate front-loading washer, below the dryer. Shared 70 × 80 × 185 cm stacking envelope; actual body / door / hose depth, service access and manufacturer stacking compatibility to verify. This arrangement does not accommodate a top loader.

customProducts.name: Separate dryer · stacked size allowance
customProducts.detail: Separate dryer above the front-load washer, with a manufacturer-approved compatible stacking kit. Heat-pump / condenser dryer is the starting direction; ventilation, drain / tank access, side and top clearances and installation conditions depend on the selected model. Not an all-in-one washer-dryer.

customFurniture.design: Left front: 70 W × 80 D × 185 H cm stack envelope for separate front-load washer and dryer. Right rear: 65 × 65 × 90 cm dishwasher bay. Right front: 60 × 50 × 90 cm shallow sink / bin module. Left rear: 60 × 25 × 170 cm hanging zone for mop, broom, dustpan and drip tray. Right upper: 125 × 30 × 65 cm cleaning cupboard, bottom 155 cm above floor.
customFurniture.fixing: Use a manufacturer-approved washer / dryer pairing and stacking kit; the dryer is not supported by ordinary cabinet joinery. Installer to check services, ventilation, circuits, hose routes, floor level / drainage and service withdrawal. Wall rack and cupboard anchors to suit the actual wall. Keep access to the window and floor traps.
customFurniture.notes: Separate dishwasher, washing machine and dryer are tracked in Electronics as generic size allowances. Bin / liner size and under-sink trap conflict remain to resolve; the sink / bin module is a space reservation, not a verified internal layout. The wall rack includes dustpan hooks and a removable drip area for wet tools. Elevated closed cleaning storage; latch / lock choice open. Utility door and window positions are scaled. Dishwasher and laundry opening rectangles use provisional 60 cm allowances. Actual door swings and installation clearances remain pending. The kitchen geometry from the source layout is retained.

customFurniture.notes: Original kitchen retained separately. Keep all requested appliance bays, utility laundry / dishwasher / sink / cleaning storage, existing doorways and hob wall. Modelled west entry ≈136 cm. Parked-stool clearance toward cooking run ≈114 cm; after a 35 cm pull-back study ≈79 cm, below the 90 cm guide. Stools must be moved / tucked for busy cooking. Check actual occupied bodies, drawer openings and the adjacent dining layout before finalising. IKEA RÄVSTEN is the linked seating reference. Published seat diameter 33 cm and seat height 62 cm; the 40 cm floor footprint is a planning allowance with leg span unverified. Price and final stool choice remain open.
